ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: I have taken a class (at school or in the community) with my health session partner.
I have worked at the same job or company with my health session partner.
I have seen my health session partner around town.
I have been at the same party or social event with my health session partner.
I have socialized or hung out one-on-one or in a small group with my health session partner.
I have socialized or hung out in a large group with my health session partner.
I have consumed alcohol with my health session partner.
I have used cannabis with my health session partner.
How often have you interacted with your health session partner?
Notes: 0=I have never seen or interacted with them before; 1=I have seen them before but never interacted with them; 2=I have had a couple of interactions with them; 3=I have had some interactions with them; 4=I have had a lot of interactions with them; 999=Skipped

ElementDescription: If you have interacted with your health session partner before, how long ago was the most recent time you two interacted?
Notes: 1=Within the past week; 2=Within the past month; 3=Within the past six months; 4=Within the past year; 5=Over one year ago; 999=Skipped

ElementDescription: How well did you know your peer health session partner?
Notes: 0=I do not know them at all; 1=I know them slightly well; 2=I know them somewhat well; 3=I know them very well; 999=Skipped

ElementDescription: How comfortable or uncomfortable were you sharing your experiences in the presence of your health session partner?
Notes: 1=I was very uncomfortable; 2=I was somewhat uncomfortable; 3=I was slightly uncomfortable; 4=I was neither comfortable nor uncomfortable; 5=I was slightly comfortable; 6=I was somewhat comfortable; 7=I was very comfortable; 999=Skipped

ElementDescription: How confident are you that your health session partner will keep your experiences private (confidential)?
Notes: 0=I am not confident at all; 1=I am slightly confident; 2=I am somewhat confident; 3=I am very confident; 999=Skipped
